brief.name: Rumah Nyonya
brief.industry: Heritage Peranakan (Straits-Chinese) atelier — hand-embroidered kebaya, beaded kasut manek slippers, and Nyonya porcelain
brief.audience: Women 30-60 in Malaysia & Singapore who value heritage craft for weddings and Hari Raya/CNY occasions; collectors of Straits-Chinese culture; diaspora buying meaningful gifts.
brief.tone: warm, heritage, unhurried, fourth-generation, quietly proud, family-recipe
brief.references: The Blue Mansion (Cheong Fatt Tze), Kim Choo Kueh Chang, kebaya ateliers of Penang & Melaka, Baba House Singapore
brief.context: Hero: tagline over a single large photograph of beadwork in progress. Sections: Atelier story (since 1948, four generations), The Collection (kebaya, kasut manek, porcelain), Craft (how a single kasut manek pair takes 3 weeks), Made-to-measure appointment booking, Visit (Armenian Street, Penang). Use Peranakan tile patterns ONLY as slim section dividers and a footer band.
brief.avoid: Full-bleed tile wallpaper. Primary red/green 'generic Asian' color. Marketing exclamation CTAs. Stock fashion photography. Treating heritage as a costume gimmick.
